questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Difference of 1st Number and 2nd Number = 146.

For,

X : 679 

⇒ X = 679 + 146

⇒ X = 825.

Similarly,

864 : Y

Thus, X = 825, Y = 718,
